verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and rendering API, so blocking image and CSS resources is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents scraping, browser actions, timeouts and screenshots, but never mentions a resource-blocking option, default or otherwise. The community comment about bandwidth concerns site operators blocking the service, not this capability, so it is ignored.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
